data_fields.name: cast_time_units
data_fields.donor_constant: header CastingTime clamped 0..10 (tenths of a round)

data_fields.name: cast_time_cap_units
data_fields.donor_constant: CastingSpeedModifier param 2 when below 10; replaces the tier value and skips haste

data_fields.name: round_length
data_fields.donor_constant: round_sec x defaultTicksPerSec, round_sec read from ROUND_SECONDS table field (value not read)

data_fields.name: disrupt_threshold_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: simple mode breaks cast when d20 < damage + spellLevel

data_fields.name: combat_casting_bonus
data_fields.donor_constant: +4 to concentration roll with Combat Casting feat (third-edition path)

data_fields.name: dispel_up_per_level
data_fields.donor_constant: +5 percent per level the dispeller is above the caster

data_fields.name: dispel_down_per_level
data_fields.donor_constant: -10 percent per level the dispeller is below the caster

best_idea: A spell's cast time is data in tenths of a round, and a hit taken mid-cast breaks it on a roll that rises with the hit's damage and the spell's level, so casting is always a gamble under pressure.
decision_why: Keep the cast-time-as-data and the hit-breaks-cast roll, but resolve the roll inside the engine's hit step on the one ledger with the threshold as data; drop the first-edition any-hit rule and the level-0 sentinel for mobile.
acceptance: In a zone or Pit fight a caster hit mid-cast shows a Disrupted cue and the cooldown is spent; a server test asserts a cast with 0 cast time opens no interrupt window and that simple mode with damage 10 and spell level 3 breaks the cast on d20 < 13.
